consequences: Frame metadata and command registry do not imply frame-content or command-execution readiness. Mock browser checks remain layout-only evidence.
context: Production operators require real per-turn diagnostics, not prototype metrics or stale successful state.
decision: Read authenticated low-sensitivity journal and health projections, retain unknown values, poll without overlap, mark stale snapshots and discard cross-conversation late responses.
title: Developer Mode uses observed evidence and freshness boundaries
